title: Give the named-root read refusal a stable reason code for a claim that is no longer the run's claim
outcome: Give the named-root read refusal a stable reason code for a claim that is no longer the run's claim
acceptance: When a named-root read is refused because the root's claim no longer belongs to the run (a newer claim replaced it), the JSON error carries a stable code and reason (for example code named_root_read_refused with reason claim_not_current_for_run), distinct from the run-unknown and other-project refusals, so a host can match it without parsing message text.
The read's existing claim block {state, holder, expires_at, revision, fence} stays unchanged in shape and meaning, and a test pins each refusal's code and reason plus the unchanged claim block.
No store-format change; the existing message text stays for older readers.

completion.summary: Landed stable named-root refusal reasons: claim_not_current_for_run, run_unknown and other_project under named_root_read_refused. Successful claim payload and existing messages remain unchanged; no store-format change.
